options.npc_answer: I just escaped with: [inventory_list]. You look like you've seen better days too. See, I have some good stuff here if you needed.

options.player_question: I've heard a helicopter landed with survivors, is this true?
options.npc_answer: Yes! They brought the plague to us, some asymptomatic carriers from the continent. It became hell after they arrived! *cough* *cough*
Brazil fell first. Then the rest. The Plague didn't care about borders. Only the islands survived. For now.
We are stuck here. We probably need some specific tools to get this crap running again!
